title: Hearty Mustardy Polish Sirloin Steak Kebabs
description: A romantic Polish dish featuring sirloin steak tips, this recipe combines the richness of mustard with the chewiness of sirloin, perfect for a special dinner, and is macrobiotic-friendly as it focuses on whole, natural ingredients and avoids processed foods.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, ensuring it reaches a safe temperature of at least 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mustard, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper to create a marinade.
Add the sirloin steak tips to the marinade and toss to coat, letting it sit for at least 10 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate the meat.
Thread the marinated steak tips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece to ensure even cooking.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit for medium-rare.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute and the meat to retain its tenderness.
Serve the kebabs over cooked brown rice, garnished with chopped fresh parsley for a pop of color and freshness.
Boil 2 cups of water and blanch the kebabs for 30 seconds to add moisture and tenderness to the dish.
